name: The Pledge of Secrecy
label: Quest
description: The Pledge of Secrecy: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Goblin engineering is about practical uses for high profit and higher explosive power! Our schemata allow us to make powerful bombs and mighty weaponry; the manual you read covered this.
The manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a goblin engineer, that's that. There is no access to gnome engineering at all.
If you still want to become a goblin engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. Think about it carefully, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you've signed the document and are ready to hand it to me, then that is that. You've been told that this is a one way trip. If you're ready, then hop on board!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome aboard, Goblin Engineer friend! You soon will have access to the most powerful engineering schemata anywhere on Azeroth.

Now that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your goblin-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your goblin engineering talents!
